summary.text: Matthew Gromlich is an assistant professor and educator in Shreveport running as a Democratic candidate for Louisiana's 4th Congressional District.
Raised in a military family, he campaigns on lowering family costs, expanding childcare and education funding, and redirecting federal spending toward domestic needs.

paragraphs.text: Gromlich was raised in a military family; according to his campaign website, his father served more than 30 years in the Coast Guard and the family moved across nine states before he put down roots in Louisiana.
He graduated from the North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics and earned a bachelor's degree in 2012 and a graduate degree in 2014 from North Carolina State University.

His campaign website says he holds a B.S. in Chemistry Education, an M.Ed. in Agriculture and Extension Education, an M.Ed. in Educational Policy and Leadership, and a Ph.D. in Curriculum and Instruction with a focus on Mathematics Education from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, which Ballotpedia dates to 2020.

He is an assistant professor at Louisiana State University Shreveport, where he teaches secondary mathematics methods, secondary science methods and educational technology courses, and he has published educational research in academic journals.
